mapper.select: SELECT A.INT_RATE intRate, B.WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT B WHERE B.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.COMPONENT_ID = A.INT_RATE_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(A.EFF_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{SESSION_SYS_DATE}

SELECT DISTINCT MF.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_NAME feeName, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FFCR.AST_VDATE_TYPE astVdateType, FFCR.BASE_RULE baseRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_DATE fAccrDate, FCI.CASH_ID cashId,
FFCRU.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FFCRU.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FFCRU.INTERVAL_RULE intervalRule, FFCRU.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE FFCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCRU, FIN_CASH_INFO FCI,
FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR
FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND FP.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID AND FCI.CASH_ID = FFCRU.CASH_ID
AND FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID
AND FCPR.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE AND FFCR.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE and FFCR.Eff_Date =
(SELECT MAX(A.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE A,FIN_CASH_INFO B,FIN_PRODUCT C WHERE C.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.CASH_ID = A.CASH_ID AND A.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{iplatformDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) AND FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID
